newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA TO SET UP CONCESSION RIGHTS ON NEW ROADS.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA TO SET UP CONCESSION RIGHTS ON NEW ROADS.

text.p: Bulgaria's cabinet decided to set up concession rights for construction of new stretches of its motorway network in a bid to attract fresh investment, a government official said.

"Extending concession rights prior to building a new road stretch will guarantee the company which is to build it that it will redeem its investment after construction is completed," the official told reporters late on Thursday after a cabinet meeting.

So far concession rights could be set up only on existing roads built through government tenders but construction companies were not guaranteed they would be granted a concession on stretches they had built.

The government also decided to speed up privatisation of 100-percent state owned sites like coal mines, stone quarries and motorways by seeking an abolition of a legal requirement that concessions on them were granted only with parliament consent.
"This amendment to the Concession Law will enable the government to act more quickly and efficiently in privatisation," said the official. -- Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 911 88
